title: Unsupported message type Error
body:
### Bug Description

This bug is related to langchain-core version 0.2.24 and causes the prompt component to break other components.



### Reproduction

Run langflow 1.0.13 and run the Basic Prompting starter project with updated OpenAI component.

### Expected behavior

The starter project should work normally.

### Who can help?

_No response_

MacOS

1.0.13

linked_prs.body:

Fixes #3022 #3009

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue involves prompt management problems and references the OpenAI component, which ties to LLM provider usage. Prompt-related issues are a key category under agent issues.
